answer: A reputation escrow plus a burn registry anchors each agent to a 0.5 ETH bond locked 90 days. Step one, commit the bond and a public identity key. Step two, any watchman who spots two identities sharing one key files a report and keeps half the slashed stake. Step three, a duplicate bond burns on ledger. Forging 10,000 identities costs $5M in locked bonds and $2.4M in burned fees before one earns a reward. A sparrow steals crumbs by darting in alone, yet here every agent flies with a numbered band; the walnut stays whole only while its shell is checked, and a cracked one gets swept away.
